title: Read-only Cloudflare local connector recovery evidence

phases.objective: Provide a workflow-dispatch-only, credential-free public health verifier for connector.mad4b.com that proves Cloudflare transport and bounded Windows local-connector identity without Hostinger branch/SHA assumptions or recovery mutations.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Connector Recovery Evidence contract job or trusted-main workflow_dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A bounded structured artifact either proves public DNS, authorized TLS, HTTP 200 JSON, service local-connector, platform win32, hashed hostname presence, and valid uptime, or fails closed with one sanitized first failure.
steps: Bind the only accepted URL to https://connector.mad4b.com/health without credentials, query, fragment, redirect following, alternate host, path, or port.
Require the canonical local-connector health route to remain unauthenticated and return service, hostname, platform, and uptime.
Require deployment policy to keep connector.mad4b.com on Cloudflare Tunnel with Hostinger Auto Deploy disabled.
Reject private, loopback, link-local, multicast, documentation, invalid, or over-cardinality DNS answers before TLS or HTTP.
Require authorized TLS, bounded complete HTTP response, HTTP 200 application/json, and valid JSON.
Require ok=true, service=local-connector, platform=win32, non-empty hostname, and non-negative uptime.
Persist only a hostname SHA-256 digest, never the raw hostname or arbitrary response fields.
Upload and enforce a structured secret-free artifact only during explicit trusted-main workflow_dispatch.
assertions: The workflow has contents:read only and no push, schedule, pull_request_target, issue_comment, or deployment trigger.
Live network probing is skipped in pull-request context and allowed only from refs/heads/main workflow_dispatch.
The workflow contains no connector credential, Authorization header, x-api-key, x-connector-secret, secret context, provider mutation, or recovery command.
The raw hostname, response body, unknown JSON fields, error details, tokens, passwords, and secrets are not persisted.
All repository, provider, credential, SQL, migration, and external-send effect flags remain false.

phases.objective: Run the trusted-main public health verifier after Windows and Cloudflare Tunnel recovery and attach the artifact to issue 4957.
Add bounded retry and Cloudflare-specific edge classification without introducing credentials or mutation.
This is a public recovery health readback, not a deployment canary.
Require a passing connector recovery artifact before declaring the break-glass surface available.
